club.title: The Club
club.about_text: Wydad Athletic Club, known as The Family, is Morocco's and Africa's oldest and most decorated club. Founded on May 8, 1937 in Casablanca by a group of passionate young Moroccans, it became a symbol of resistance and national identity.
club.history_text: Wydad Athletic Club was born on 8 May 1937 in the old medina of Casablanca, under the French Protectorate, founded by a group of Casablanca patriots. Its name, “Wydad”, means “love” and “sincere affection” in Arabic. The founders deliberately left “Casablanca” out of the name: the club was to be Moroccan and national, not regional.
club.stadium_text: Wydad play their home matches at Stade Mohammed V in Casablanca, one of the most iconic stadiums in Africa. With a capacity of 44,500 spectators, it delivers an exceptional atmosphere at every match.
club.supporters_text: The Ultras Winners, founded in 2005, were named the best fan group in the world by the Ultras World collective in 2015 and 2019.
club.source: Sources: French Wikipedia, “Wydad Athletic Club (football)”, and club communications.

fans.title: Fans
fans.intro: Wydad is its supporters first. Podcasts, the stands, lifelong members and an online community: the home of Wydad Athletic Club’s fans.
fans.podcasts_text: The official Wydad podcast is on its way: previews, debriefs, guests and club stories, to listen to anywhere.
fans.ultras_text: The Ultras Winners, founded in 2005, were named the best fan group in the world by the Ultras World collective in 2015 and 2019. Tifos, chants and passion that light up the Mohammed V complex every match.
fans.historic_members_text: A space to honour members who have been loyal for decades, with their memories and stories from the stands.
fans.community_text: A server for Wydadis to meet: matchday chat, live discussion, club news and conversations with the community.
fans.gold_text: Wydad’s gold card: private box, premium hospitality and exclusive privileges. First holder: Yassine Bounou.

swimming.title: Swimming
swimming.intro: Juniors, elites and former internationals: Wydad’s swimming section trains its swimmers in and out of the pool, with water polo in the same family.
swimming.stage_text: From 19 to 24 October 2026, Wydad’s swimmers are at Club CIH in Bouznika: intensive sessions, technique, conditioning and team spirit, led by head coach Aymen Riadi with Karima El Marhar and Monsef Daghai.
swimming.physio_text: The section strengthens its partnership with physiotherapist Khadija Aboutaib, at the club’s side for many years, to follow swimmers in competition, training and recovery.
swimming.internationals_text: Badreddine Bouchouirab, the section’s delegate president and head of the Casablanca-Settat league, and Brahim Tahsi, regional aquatics manager at SONARGES, both swam and played water polo for Morocco.
swimming.gallery_text: Red and white years by the pool, shared by the section on its Facebook page.

boxing.title: Boxing
boxing.intro: Technique, discipline and family spirit: Wydad’s gym welcomes boxers of all ages, from first gloves to the Moroccan championship.
boxing.mouti_text: Wydad congratulates boxer Taha Mouti on his silver medal at the Moroccan championship. The best is yet to come.
boxing.training_text: Sparring, technical work and conditioning: the boxing section’s daily routine, on its official account.

fencing.title: Fencing
fencing.intro: Foil, épée, sabre: Wydad’s fencing section is raising a generation of young fencers up to international level.
fencing.zaimi_title: Hiba Zaimi at the Dakar 2026 YOG
fencing.zaimi_text: An under-15 cadet in her first year, Hiba Zaimi will represent Morocco at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games in women’s foil, in the under-20 junior category.
fencing.antidoping_text: Our fencers took the ADEL course of the Moroccan Anti-Doping Agency (AMAD) in Rabat with their parents and coach, on the road to Dakar 2026.
fencing.next_gen_title: The future is in good hands
fencing.next_gen_text: The section’s young champions already fly the red and white colours on the piste.

handball.coach_text: Coach Abdelmajid Zaouli renews with the handball section for one season, renewable, to keep the first team stable.

academy.summer_camp_text: A successful first edition in July 2026: football, workshops, discoveries and plenty of smiles for the young campers.

bounou.title: Yassine Bounou, El Mítico
bounou.intro: Moroccan international goalkeeper Yassine Bounou is the first holder of the Wydad Athletic Club Gold Membership.
bounou.tifo_text: In 2025, at the match against Sevilla FC, his former club, the Winners 2005 dedicated a tifo to him: “El Mítico”.
